name: variant.diff
title: Show variant difference
summary: What a variant adds, replaces and excludes compared to the core.

variant.description: The variant. An element whose type has no meaning `variant` is `input.invalid` with `details.reason: "not-a-variant"`; an unknown or ambiguous reference is `ref.unknown` or `ref.ambiguous`.

added.description: Requirements whose validity names the variant and that replace no core requirement that is not excluded in it (SR-044 AK1), also the source of a replaces onto an element that is no core requirement (SR-041 AK8). Store order.

replaced.description: One row per pair, in store order of the core requirement, then of the replacement: two replacements of one core requirement are two rows (SR-041 AK7). A core requirement that is also excluded is not here (SR-042 AK5).

excluded.description: Core requirements the variant excludes, also when replaced too; store order.

names.description: Every element the lists name, each once, in order first named (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#588). Left out when it names none.

problems.description: The variant.target-not-core hints of the variant's own entries and of its replacements.

incomplete.description: A repository is not here: a replacement or exclusion stored there is missing (SR-006 AK2).
